faq03.answer: Abandoned cart recovery is available with the Pro package. Merchants can customize the message content and set the timing for when it’s sent. A cart is considered abandoned when a user adds a product to the cart within the app without completing the purchase, even if they’re not logged in. A reminder notification is then automatically sent to the customer at no additional cost.
